subject: Restart daemon to activate claim-session endpoint
description: The orchestrator daemon at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid needs a restart to pick up changes to routes/overlay.js (new /overlay/claim-session endpoint) and routes/session.js (cross-session claim lookup). Run: cd /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid && npm start or whatever the daemon start command is (check package.json). The daemon process may be running on port 8787.
